gen-gf-julee-fs-fira-sans: Friendly and relaxed, Julee packs its small, chunky letters tightly together like bundled cable, while Fira Sans opens its curves wide and wears a larger x-height. They feel like a doodle next to a printed label.
gen-gf-julee-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with a tall x-height and smooth, unobstructed curves, leaving Julee's pressed-together, hand-drawn letters to supply the personality. Down a longer block of text, it would read quietly and keep out of the way.
gen-gf-julee-manrope: Chunky, hand-drawn, and a bit cheeky. Julee earns its keep big and short, where its tightly pressed letters get room to show off, while Manrope stays bright, open, and drawn with a single line width.
gen-gf-julee-montserrat: Julee's letters are pressed tightly together, thick for their height, like bundled cable and clearly drawn by hand. Montserrat then lets geometric curves glide beneath it, with oversized e and a counters that give the crowded heading some breathing space.
gen-gf-julee-satoshi: Julee has a friendly, hand-drawn look, with small, thick letters pressed close together in narrow channels of space. And Satoshi, with its soaring x-height and wide-open e, gives that warmth a cool, uncluttered partner.
gen-gf-julee-switzer: Switzer reads tall and tubular, with wire-like letterforms and c tips that never creep toward touching. Julee earns its keep big and short, where its pressed-together, hand-drawn letters can be relaxed and friendly.
gen-gf-julee-work-sans: Julee brings a relaxed, hand-drawn friendliness, its small thick letters pressed together in narrow channels, and it is not meant for long paragraphs. Work Sans sits beneath it, modern and contemporary, with a high mean line.
gen-gf-kablammo-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, with almost no step between its lowercase and its capitals. Kablammo stands over it with wide-spaced, very tall letters, setting a deliberate pace that the body follows.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-amulya: Loose, friendly handwriting leads, with Kavivanar's constant stroke and an s that flares open at both ends. Amulya follows in a contemporary, modern voice, its generous curve gaps giving the page a tidy footing.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-neco: Dignified describes Neco, a classic serif whose measured swell from hairline to stem never pinches its letters shut. Neco is best left at modest sizes, while Kavivanar's relaxed, hand-drawn stroke handles the headline.
